problem_text:
A logistics manager must select packages to load onto a cargo drone. Available packages are:
* Package A: volume 11 cubic feet, revenue $99
* Package B: volume 50 cubic feet, revenue $91
* Package C: volume 41 cubic feet, revenue $134
* Package D: volume 40 cubic feet, revenue $178
* Package E: volume 2 cubic feet, revenue $257
* Package F: volume 41 cubic feet, revenue $213
* Package G: volume 3 cubic feet, revenue $125
* Package H: volume 16 cubic feet, revenue $154
* Package I: volume 22 cubic feet, revenue $97
* Package J: volume 16 cubic feet, revenue $190
* Package K: volume 15 cubic feet, revenue $93
* Package L: volume 27 cubic feet, revenue $247
* Package M: volume 24 cubic feet, revenue $299
* Package N: volume 9 cubic feet, revenue $207
The drone's cargo hold has a maximum capacity of 221 cubic feet. Choose the package combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each package is either fully loaded or left behind.
